Resource Profile: PH Core Provenance

Official URL: https://fhir.doh.gov.ph/phcore/StructureDefinition/ph-core-provenance Version: 0.2.1
Draft as of 2026-10-23 Maturity Level: 0 Computable Name: PHCoreProvenance

This profile identifies the resources described by an activity, when the activity was recorded, and the agents responsible for creating, updating, or transmitting the information.

Purpose

Use PH Core Provenance to identify the resources described by an activity, when it was recorded, and who created, updated, or transmitted the information.

Required content

Every conforming record MUST contain:

  • At least one target, identifying the resource described by this record.
  • recorded, the date and time the activity was recorded, including a timezone.
  • At least one agent, with agent.who identifying who participated.

Agent roles and organizations

Use author and transmitter agents to distinguish responsibility for the information from its transmission:

  • Author: the individual, organization, or device responsible for creating or updating the information described by the activity.
  • Transmitter: the entity that provided the copy to the receiving system.

Each author or transmitter slice is optional. When present, its type MUST include the corresponding author or transmitter coding. Other agent types are allowed.

When agent.who is a Practitioner or Device, agent.onBehalfOf SHALL identify the represented PH Core Organization.

Usages:

  • CapabilityStatements using this Profile: CapabilityStatement[https://fhir.doh.gov.ph/phcore/CapabilityStatement/PHCoreServerCapabilityStatement|0.2.1]
  • This Profile is not used by any profiles in this Specification

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics

dom-2 error Provenance If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources contained.contained.empty()
dom-3 error Provenance If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()

ele-1 error **ALL** elements All FHIR elements must have a @value or children hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())

Clinical examples

  • Blood pressure with authorship: an Observation returned with its author Provenance.
  • Allergy with authorship and transmission: an AllergyIntolerance returned with author and transmitter Provenance records.

The clinical resource and its Provenance appear together in each search response. Use _revinclude=Provenance:target on a server that supports the requested search and reverse inclusion.

References and time

Element Guidance
target Use a literal reference when available; identify the resource version when known and relevant to the activity.
agent.who Use PH Core Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Organization, Patient, or RelatedPerson; use base FHIR Device for a device.
location Reference PH Core Location when a location is supplied.
recorded The instant the activity was recorded, with a timezone. It can differ from both the activity time and the target resource's update time.
occurred[x] Optional activity time, expressed as a dateTime or Period. Use it when that time is known and useful.

To validate provenance-1, provide access to the resource referenced by agent.who so that resolve() can determine its type. If the reference cannot be resolved, check the participant type and required onBehalfOf separately; an unresolved reference does not establish conformance.

Actor responsibilities

Selected paths Client and Server when producing resources Client and Server when receiving resources
target, recorded, agent, agent.who, and type in each named agent slice SHALL be able to populate these elements. SHALL handle these elements.
target.reference, general agent.type, each named agent slice, and agent.onBehalfOf SHALL populate these elements when their values are known and permitted to be shared. SHALL handle these elements.

Population capability and population when known are distinct from element cardinality. Handling applies when processing received resources; it is not a substitute for a missing value. Apply the required-content and onBehalfOf conditions above when populating an instance.

Draft attribution scope

The current provenance-1 condition requires an Organization when the agent is a Practitioner or Device. The examples show institutional attribution. Independent practitioners and patient-held devices may not represent an Organization; those use cases require further appraisal of this draft condition. Do not invent an organization solely to satisfy the example pattern.
